channel.title: Workspace Members on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Workspace Members on KubeSphere

item.title: Invite Users to a Workspace
item.description: This section describes how to invite users to a workspace. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Member Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. A user has been created in Users and Roles Management. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: View Workspace Member List
item.description: This section describes how to view the workspace member list. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Member View permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Workspace Settings > Workspace Members in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Modify Workspace Member Roles
item.description: This section describes how to modify the roles of workspace members. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Member Management permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Workspace Settings > Workspace Members in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Remove Workspace Members
item.description: This section describes how to remove workspace members. Note After a user is removed from a workspace, they will lose the permissions granted by the workspace role. If the user has joined projects within the workspace, they will also be removed from those projects. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Member Management permission in the workspace.
